name: Jatobá

ancestryFeatures.name: Nimble
ancestryFeatures.text: Gain a permanent +1 bonus to your Evasion at character creation.

ancestryFeatures.name: Shell
ancestryFeatures.text: Gain a bonus to your damage thresholds equal to your Proficiency.

communityFeature.name: Low-Light Living
communityFeature.text: When you're in an area with low light or heavy shadow, you have advantage on rolls to hide, investigate, or perceive details within that area.

features.name: I Am the Weapon
features.text: While you are unarmed, your unarmed strikes deal d8 physical damage using your Strength or Agility trait (your choice), and you gain a +1 bonus to your Evasion.

loadout.name: Bare Bones
loadout.text:
When you choose not to equip armor, you have a base Armor Score of 3 + your Strength and use the following as your base damage thresholds:

  - Tier 1: 9/19
  - Tier 2: 11/24
  - Tier 3: 13/31
  - Tier 4: 15/38

loadout.name: Untouchable
loadout.text: Gain a bonus to your Evasion equal to half your Agility.

loadout.name: Ferocity
loadout.text: When you cause an adversary to mark 1 or more Hit Points, you can spend 2 Hope to increase your Evasion by the number of Hit Points they marked. This bonus lasts until after the next attack made against you.

backgroundNotes: A Simiah martial artist whose agile monkey frame carries the natural, impenetrable shell of the ancient Galapa. Like the Brazilian Jatobá tree, he moves with natural flexibility and possesses wood-and-stone resilience.
